ProxiesNFT is a one of a kind detailed generative art in a collection of 6000 High-fidelity artworks. Each NFT represents a distinct, handcrafted design that showcases the artist's creativity and capabilities.

ProxiesNFT is focused on fostering a strong, loyal community through interactive events and initiatives. As the project evolves, ProxiesNFT aims to explore new partnership opportunities, and expand its reach within the NFT landscape.
